preconditions.description: The number of commands N must be between 1 and 1000.
Each command must have a length of at most 100 characters.
Each command must end with a period.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(command[11:] for command in commands if command.startswith('Simon says'))
postconditions.description: The output must contain only the parts of commands that start with 'Simon says', excluding the phrase itself.
